activity_summary: At home the letter stayed on the nail, unfolded, with no day. The loaf stayed under the cloth. Nobody put it to the notch. Dinner was the board, and the sheet was not a guest at it.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Refused a measuring, and called dinner.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left the loaf under the cloth.

entities.name: the letter
